snippet.title: This New Game Looks Amazing! - Tears Apart Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the official gameplay trailer for Tears Apart! In this video, we show you the action, combat and art style of this awesome upcoming game. If you love fast action and smooth gameplay, you definitely need to keep an eye on this one. Indie game for action roguelike fans.

What do you think of the trailer? Let us know your thoughts in the comments below!
